name: Svetlana Rostova
source:
Svetlana works as a gymnastics teacher at the high school. (She is the team coach for Isabella, Mila, Polly, and Sophia.) She is also a dance teacher on the side, mostly because she loves to dance.

She is Russian and married to a gay man. (It is a marriage of convenience, he married her to hide his sexuality and she married him to get a citizenship.)
